info.title: ITSM API
info.description: D02a foundation + D02 domain read contract + D03 permission foundation + D05 dashboard aggregates + D06 ticket List/Board (filters, keyset cursor, whole-scope counts) and status/PIC mutations + C32 private saved views. Every operation is authorised server-side, default deny: a workspace the caller cannot see answers 404, a visible workspace without the needed permission answers 403 forbidden; each such 403 to a member leaves one append-only audit_events row (action access.denied, outcome denied, safe projection: permission, method, route template; no IDs, query or body). 404, 401 and CSRF refusals write no row. Business permissions come from the role (cs, lead_cs); administration and integration rights come only from explicit workspace grants. Permission endpoints are UI metadata, never a source of access. Domain-rule refusals answer 422 rule_violation with a generic message; optimistic-lock conflicts answer 409 version_conflict. Source of truth for BE/FE; TS types are generated from this file. UAT only: direct Superadmin entry on a marked dummy database. Production and SSO are not available. D07: idempotent ticket intake (O05), PIC history, Jira/Lark SIMULATION outbox with permissioned retry/reconcile. + D08c saved-view List columns (allowlist, persisted per user+workspace) and the simulated outbox worker (claim lease, bounded transient retry with backoff, expired lease → unknown). + D10 operational company reports (O06/C21/C22): server preview over the whole scope (Jakarta-day period, received/resolved basis, status + PIC/kanal/kategori/prioritas filters, unique tickets vs resolution cycles kept apart) and an idempotent, audited CSV export with scoped download, SHA-256, expiry and formula-injection neutralization. Official BI/regulator report stays held (422 regulator_mapping_unavailable); the export is labelled non-regulator.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-itsm_session
sessionCookie.description: Server-side session. Plain-HTTP local UAT uses the cookie name `itsm_session`.

csrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfHeader.description: Required on every unsafe method under /api/v1 except UAT entry.

WorkspaceId.name: workspace_id
WorkspaceId.description: Unknown, malformed or foreign IDs all return 404.

TicketId.name: ticket_id
TicketId.description: Scoped to workspace_id; a ticket of another workspace returns 404.

AttachmentId.name: attachment_id
AttachmentId.description: Scoped to workspace_id and ticket_id; otherwise 404.

SavedViewId.name: saved_view_id
SavedViewId.description: Own view in workspace_id only; another user's view or another workspace returns 404.

OutboxId.name: outbox_id
OutboxId.description: Integration outbox intent in workspace_id only; another workspace = 404.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: One key per intake draft, scoped to user + workspace. Same key + same payload replays the original ticket; same key + other payload = 409. Reuse the key when retrying after a timeout.

ReportIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
ReportIdempotencyKey.description: One key per export request, scoped to user + workspace. Same key + same request replays the run (200, replayed=true); same key + another request = 409.

TicketRef.description: Workspace-scoped reference with its display label (people have no code).

TicketAllowedAction.description: A status change the caller may request now (D01 lifecycle + caller permissions). The server re-checks everything on submit.

blockedBy.description: Why the action is refused right now; the UI shows it disabled with this explanation.

TicketListItem.description: Safe ticket projection shared by List and Board. No identity numbers or contact data.

ageSeconds.description: Seconds since receivedAt; no SLA meaning.

TicketAppliedFilters.description: Echo of the applied filters (`null` = no restriction).

TicketListBasis.description: How numbers are counted. Dimension filters use the ticket's CURRENT PIC/kanal/kategori/prioritas (operational scope, not a historical report). With a resolution range a ticket with several resolve events in the range is listed and counted once; `resolutionEvents` counts the events.

total.description: Tickets in the whole filtered scope (all pages).

countsByStatus.description: Same scope without the status filter; `closed` only when present.

resolutionEvents.description: Resolve events in the range for tickets in scope; only with a resolution range.

nextCursor.description: Opaque; bound to workspace, filters and sort.

total.description: Server count of the whole column before paging.

reason.description: Required to replace/remove another PIC (ticket.assign_any); refused when taking an unassigned ticket for oneself.

field.description: validation_failed only: the request field to fix (camelCase, `jira.title` style for nested fields).

retryAfterSeconds.description: rate_limited only: seconds until the next request is accepted (same value as the Retry-After header).

challengeId.description: mfa_required only: the single-use second-step challenge for POST /api/v1/login/mfa (expires after 5 minutes).

uat.description: Present only in UAT Superadmin mode; null/absent otherwise.

username.description: Null for users without a local credential.

locked.description: Currently locked out after failed password or TOTP attempts (cleared by POST /users/{user_id}/unlock).

mfaEnrolled.description: CP4b: has a confirmed TOTP authenticator. Never exposes the seed or recovery codes.

company.description: CP5d. Null without an active membership.

mustChangePassword.description: US-1.4: true while the user must change the password; every route except the account and session paths answers 403 until then.

platformAdmin.description: CP3b: holds the platform_admin grant (password mode); the client offers the user administration page only then.

mfaEnabled.description: ITSM_MFA (default off): the server offers MFA at all. False = plain password login, no pre-MFA session, no step-up, the /me/mfa, /login/mfa and /session/step-up routes answer 404 and the client hides every MFA screen. Always false in UAT Superadmin mode.

mfaEnrolled.description: US-1.2: password mode, the user has a confirmed TOTP authenticator. Always false in UAT Superadmin mode.

mfaRequired.description: US-1.2: MFA is mandatory for this user (platform_admin, or a live admin.*, integration.* or ai.manage grant). While required and not verified, the session is pre-MFA: only session, CSRF refresh, logout-all, meta and the /me/mfa enrolment routes answer; everything else is 403 forbidden.

otpauthUri.description: otpauth://totp URI (SHA1, 6 digits, 30 s) holding the seed. Shown once; never returned again or logged.

recoveryCodes.description: Ten single-use codes, shown once. Only HMAC-SHA256 digests are stored; any earlier batch is spent.

csrfToken.description: Returned once; keep in memory only.

brandName.description: Name shown next to the logo: the branding display name, else the company name.

grants.description: Live grants; empty unless the caller holds admin.members.

TicketStatus.description: Internal code + UI label. `closed` is a read-only historical archive state: never selectable, never mapped to resolved. Close final is not available.

code.description: Unique per workspace. Priority codes are the existing low/normal/high/urgent.

number.description: Atomic per-workspace counter; unique within the workspace.

displayNumber.description: KODEWORKSPACE-number for display only. Not a BI regulator code.

ownerUserId.description: PIC CS; active member of this workspace, null = unassigned.

version.description: Optimistic lock; a stale version on mutation answers 409 version_conflict.

Attachment.description: Metadata only. No object key or download URL; download with ACL re-check is a later task.

scanStatus.description: pending | clean | infected | scan_error | scanner_unavailable | rejected

ReportRun.description: Operational report run (D10: synchronous CSV/XLSX export). Official BI export is held. The artifact reference is not exposed.

hasArtifact.description: The run produced an artifact (D02 meaning). Use downloadable for the download link.

downloadable.description: True while the stored artifact (CSV or XLSX) can be downloaded (not expired).

artifactSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes served by the download.

format.description: Artifact format (D13). Runs before D13 are csv.

persistent.description: The banner must stay visible on every screen and cannot be dismissed.

superadminProvesRbac.description: Superadmin sees everything; its access is not evidence for CS/Lead CS permissions.

source.description: grant = only via an explicit workspace grant, never from a role

role.description: null for UAT Superadmin without membership

permissions.description: Effective for this request; UI hint only, the server re-checks every call.

DashboardPeriodKey.description: Calendar periods in the workspace time zone. last_7_days = today minus 6 days through today; this_month = the whole calendar month.

TicketFilter.description: Drilldown parameters for the ticket list (D06: GET /tickets and /tickets/board accept these keys as query parameters; lists are comma-separated). Already scoped to the workspace in the path; absent keys mean no filter. The dashboard's shared filters (owner/channel/category/priority) are always included. Time bounds are half-open [from, before).

owner.description: Member user UUID, or the literal `unassigned`.

channel.description: Intake channel UUID, or the literal `none`.

DashboardPeriod.description: Period bounds. Which date each number uses is given per metric in Dashboard.metricBasis.

DashboardAppliedFilters.description: Echo of the shared filters applied to every number; null = no restriction.

active.description: False for an inactive membership/catalog row (still filterable for history).

DashboardFilterOptions.description: Filter values scoped to this workspace: members (active, or holding tickets) and catalog rows.

DashboardBasis.description: current_status = snapshot at asOf, not period-bound; received_at = received in the period; resolution_event = resolve events in the period (one per cycle, kept after reopen); resolution_event_distinct_ticket = distinct tickets with such an event.

DashboardTotals.description: Aggregated server-side over the whole workspace scope after the shared filters, never over a page.

tickets.description: All tickets in scope, any status (snapshot).

active.description: new + open + pending_customer + pending_engineering now (snapshot, not period-bound).

unassigned.description: Active tickets without a PIC now.

resolvedInPeriod.description: Resolve events (cycles) with occurred_at in the period, whatever the ticket's received_at; a later reopen does not remove them.

unassigned.description: Null when the PIC filter is a person (the number is 0 by definition).

attention.description: Null when the priority filter excludes every urgent/high priority.

DashboardPicLoad.description: Every active ticket in scope per PIC, whatever its received_at. One row per active member (0 included), per inactive member still holding active tickets, plus a final unassigned row (userId null) unless the PIC filter is a person. With a PIC filter only that row is listed.

DashboardDimensionCount.description: Tickets received in the period per catalog value (intake channel or category); null id = not recorded. With a filter on that dimension only the selected value is listed.

DashboardAgeBucket.description: Active tickets by age since received_at. Not an SLA breach.

DashboardTrendPoint.description: received = tickets by received_at; resolved = resolve events (cycles). Never summed.

DashboardAttention.description: Operational rule, not an SLA: active urgent/high tickets in scope, urgent first then oldest received; at most `limit` items, `total` over the scope.

Dashboard.description: Read-only snapshot from one REPEATABLE READ transaction. The shared filters narrow every number, chart, table and drilldown using the ticket's current owner/channel/category/priority. Synthetic dummy data in UAT.

SavedViewQuery.description: List/Board filters and sort in the List query-string format (same rules as the List parameters). Search text (`q`), `limit` and `cursor` are not allowed. Stored in canonical form; `sort`/`order` are always present in responses.

columns.description: Shown optional columns in canonical order; all six when the view stores none.

name.description: Trimmed; unique per user+workspace (case-insensitive, 422). Label only; do not put personal data in it.

columns.description: Allowlisted columns; duplicates are dropped and the order is canonicalised. Unknown or empty = 400.
Allowlisted columns; duplicates are dropped and the order is canonicalised. Unknown or empty = 400.

version.description: The version the client saw; stale = 409.

SavedViewRenameRequest.description: Rename and/or change the shown columns; at least one of name/columns (400 otherwise).

TicketJiraRequest.description: Jira link for the new ticket. create = new related work + Jira issue (live: created via the outbox, idempotent); link = existing issue key (live: verified at delivery).

title.description: Required for create; optional related-work title for link.

assigneeId.description: Jira assignee of this workspace's connection (live: from the Jira user search).

TicketCreateRequest.description: Company = the workspace in the path (never sent). Optional catalog ids must be active and in this workspace. No regulator-mandatory field is assumed (D01 freeze).

chronology.description: Free text; may hold personal data, so it is never copied into audit or logs. Request body limit 64 KB applies.

receivedAt.description: RFC 3339 with offset (UI sends Asia/Jakarta wall time +07:00). Not more than 5 minutes in the future.

merchantId.description: Dummy merchant of this workspace (no CIF lookup).

ownerUserId.description: PIC: null, yourself (ticket.assign_self) or any active member (ticket.assign_any; otherwise 403).

larkDestinationId.description: Dummy Lark destination (SIMULATION) for the ticket-created notification.

state.description: pending = not settled yet; failed = definite failure (retry allowed); unknown = outcome cannot be known (reconcile with evidence, never blind retry). A pending row with nextAttemptAt had a transient failure (not delivered) and is retried automatically with backoff.

nextAttemptAt.description: Transient failure: when the worker tries again automatically.

autoAttempts.description: Automatic attempts since the last manual retry (max 5, then failed).

inFlight.description: An attempt is claimed and not settled yet. A claim that outlives its lease becomes unknown.

issueUrl.description: https link to the Jira issue (live only).

source.description: dummy rows are offered only in simulation mode.

options.description: Jira: assignees picked before (search Jira for more). Lark: chats the bot belongs to. Empty when not usable.

usable.description: Active and configured for the server mode.

jira.description: null = not configured for this workspace.

evidence.description: What was checked at the provider (no secrets). Stored on the intent; audit records only that it was given.

issueKey.description: Required for a successful jira_create_issue; refused otherwise.

merchant.description: Dummy CIF directory; not editable in D08a.

JiraLink.description: Jira issue link; status is informational and never completes work.

completionState.description: Local completion; independent of Jira status.

AttachmentMeta.description: Metadata of an attachment bound to the ticket (bound implies a clean scan). No object key, no URL.

readOnly.description: Closed archive; every write is refused (422).

TicketPropertiesRequest.description: Only the fields present change; `null` clears a nullable field. A new catalog value must be active in this workspace (422 validation_failed otherwise).

version.description: Ticket version the client saw; stale = 409.

label.description: Server-built sentence from safe audit fields; never free text.

replayed.description: true = same Idempotency-Key and payload already accepted; nothing new written.

adapterConfigured.description: No omnichannel adapter exists in this build: always false, nothing can be sent.

SavedViewColumn.description: Optional List column. Number and title are always shown.

brandName.description: Display name override; null = the company name.

previousCodes.description: Codes this workspace used before, oldest first. Tickets issued under them keep their numbers (e.g. DUMA-5) and the codes stay reserved for this workspace.

code.description: Business code of the company and its workspace: prefix of NEW ticket numbers. Changing it never renumbers existing tickets. A code used (now or before) by another workspace is refused with 422 field code.

CompanyProfilePatchRequest.description: Company administration (UAT Superadmin): profile, business code and branding. code is required; brandKey and brandName are required and may be null, so omitting them never clears the branding. Internal ids never change; the reporter code is separate from the workspace code.

mode.description: Mode the connection was last configured/tested in; a connection from the other mode is not used.

keyringConfigured.description: ITSM_KEYRING is set (credentials can be stored).

ReportBasis.description: `received`: received_at in the period. `resolved`: at least one resolve event in the period (a later reopen keeps it).

ReportHeader.description: Company header from the database (one workspace = one reporting company). Never taken from the client.

tickets.description: Unique tickets in the report = rows of the export.

resolutionCycles.description: Resolve events in the period among those tickets (never added to tickets).

resolvedTickets.description: Distinct tickets with at least one resolve event in the period.

owner.description: PIC display name; null = belum ditugaskan.

ReportPreview.description: One REPEATABLE READ snapshot: totals, breakdowns and rows read the same SQL source as the export. Rows are the first previewLimit in export order; totals cover every row.

format.description: Default csv. xlsx = real Office Open XML workbook (sheet Data = CSV columns with typed date/number cells, sheet Ringkasan = header, filters, totals). User strings are always string cells, never formulas. The format is part of the idempotency fingerprint.

ReportRunFilters.description: Validated filters of the run (null = not filtered). Empty object for runs created before D10.

BrandKey.description: Branding preset bundled with the web app (logo + palette). null = not configured: neutral look. No URL or upload is accepted.

code.description: A 6-digit TOTP code or an unused recovery code.

reason.description: Why the factor is reset; trimmed, stored in the audit event.

IntegrationSettings.description: Non-secret connection settings. Jira: baseUrl/email/projectKey/issueTypeId + mappings; Lark: appId (+ optional baseUrl).

priorityMap.description: ITSM priority code → Jira priority id.

statusMap.description: ITSM ticket status → Jira status id (stored only; no automatic transition).

IntegrationCredential.description: Write-only secret: only whether it is stored and when it was replaced.

IntegrationConfigRequest.description: Jira: baseUrl (https, public host), email, projectKey, optional issueTypeId and mappings. Lark: appId, optional baseUrl. Changing the target returns the connection to draft.

IntegrationCredentialRequest.description: Jira API token or Lark app secret. Encrypted with the server keyring; never returned or logged.

HomeCompany.description: CP5d. The user's one company: the home membership the server resolves (oldest active membership in an active workspace).

grants.description: Live administration grants of the home membership.

Forbidden.description: Workspace is visible but the caller lacks the permission (default deny)

RuleViolation.description: Refused by a domain rule; generic message, no SQL or scoped data

InvalidRequest.description: A query parameter is not valid (invalid_request)

ValidationFailed.description: A field is missing, out of range, inactive or outside this workspace (validation_failed + field)

IdempotencyConflict.description: Idempotency-Key already used by this user in this workspace for a different payload (idempotency_conflict); nothing created

DependencyUnavailable.description: A dependency (storage, upload slots) is not available (dependency_unavailable); nothing bound

AttachmentTooLarge.description: File is larger than the configured cap (attachment_too_large)

AttachmentTypeRefused.description: Server-side sniffing found a type other than PDF/PNG/JPEG (attachment_type_refused)

AttachmentRejected.description: rule_violation (closed ticket) or attachment_infected (scanner verdict; file deleted, not bound)

ScanFailed.description: clamd reached but gave no verdict (scan_failed); file deleted, not bound

ScannerUnavailable.description: scanner_unavailable (clamd not configured/unreachable, file deleted, not bound) or dependency_unavailable

RegulatorMappingUnavailable.description: Official BI / regulator report requested: held until a verified mapping exists (regulator_mapping_unavailable). Nothing is created.

ReportExpired.description: The report artifact expired (report_expired); create a new export.

RateLimited.description: rate_limited: too many requests for this user (reads and writes counted separately) or, without a session, for this client address. Nothing was processed. Limits are per server process. Clients must not retry mutations automatically.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next request is accepted.

ProviderError.description: The provider refused or failed the call (provider_error); message is a safe summary, never a secret

KeyringMissing.description: ITSM_KEYRING is not configured on the server (keyring_missing); credentials cannot be stored or read

IntegrationConflict.description: Stale version (version_conflict), connection not configured or without credential (integration_not_configured), configured for the other server mode (integration_mode_mismatch), or server not in live mode (integration_not_live)

get.summary: Caller's own saved views in this workspace (C32)
get.description: Private to the session user and workspace; no public/shared views. A view grants nothing: List/Board re-check permission and filters when it is applied.

post.summary: Save the current List/Board filters and sort as a private view
post.description: Filters are parsed and validated against the workspace (foreign/unknown IDs = 400). Duplicate name or more than 50 views = 422.

post.summary: Change a ticket's status (D01 lifecycle)
post.description: move between active statuses (ticket.transition); resolve with `summary` (ticket.resolve; open blocking related work = 422); reopen a resolved ticket to `open` with `reason` (next cycle). `closed` is a read-only archive and never a target (422). Stale `version` = 409 and nothing changes. Resolution event, status/version and audit entry commit atomically.

200.description: Updated ticket and the audit entry written in the same transaction

post.summary: Change a ticket's PIC (D01 assignment policy)
post.description: CS/Lead CS may take an unassigned ticket for themselves (no reason). Replacing or removing another PIC needs ticket.assign_any and a `reason` (audited). The new PIC must be an active member of this workspace (422 otherwise). Stale `version` = 409.

200.description: Updated ticket and the audit entry written in the same transaction
Database reachable and runtime guard holds

post.description: Direct UAT Superadmin entry. Only in UAT mode on a database marked as dummy test. Requires header `X-ITSM-UAT-Entry: 1`.

D11. Re-issues the CSRF synchronizer token of the current session (a reloaded tab keeps the HttpOnly cookie but lost the in-memory token). Requires the session cookie and header `X-ITSM-CSRF-Refresh: 1`; when the browser sends `Sec-Fetch-Site` it must be `same-origin`. Rotates the token: the previous token of this session stops working. Sets no cookie.

200.description: New CSRF token (shown once; only its digest is stored)

post.description: US-1.6. Revokes every session of the caller (revoked_reason logout_all), including this one, records auth event logout_all and clears the cookie. Requires the CSRF token.

US-1.4. Password mode only. Changes the caller's own password: new password at least 12 characters, not the username, not the current password. Raises credential_version, revokes the caller's other sessions (password_change) and keeps this one; clears must_change_password. While must_change_password is set, every other route except session, CSRF refresh, logout-all and meta answers 403 forbidden. Requires the CSRF token. Failures are audited without secrets.

get.description: US-1.2. The caller's MFA state. Allowed in a pre-MFA session. Never returns the seed or codes. Password mode only (404 otherwise); 503 dependency_unavailable when MFA keys are not configured.

delete.description: CP4b. Removes the caller's own authenticator and recovery codes. 409 mfa_required_for_role when MFA is mandatory for the caller (platform_admin or an admin.*/integration.*/ai.manage grant). 204 without change when nothing is enrolled. Needs a step-up within the last 5 minutes (POST /session/step-up), else 401 step_up_required; the guard runs after the permission check, so a caller without the right still gets 403. Audited as mfa_disable. Requires the CSRF token. Password mode only (404 otherwise); 503 dependency_unavailable when MFA keys are not configured.

post.description: US-1.2. Starts a TOTP enrolment: a new 20-byte seed, stored only encrypted (purpose totp_seed). An unconfirmed earlier enrolment is replaced. 409 mfa_already_enrolled once confirmed. Allowed in a pre-MFA session. Requires the CSRF token. Password mode only (404 otherwise); 503 dependency_unavailable when MFA keys are not configured.

201.description: Enrolment started; the URI is shown once

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store: the body is shown once.

post.description: US-1.2. Proves the authenticator with a first valid code, activates MFA, marks this session MFA-verified and returns 10 recovery codes once. A wrong code is 422 validation_failed (field code) and keeps the session. 410 mfa_enrollment_expired after 10 minutes. Audited as mfa_enroll. Requires the CSRF token. Password mode only (404 otherwise); 503 dependency_unavailable when MFA keys are not configured.

200.description: MFA active; recovery codes shown once

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store: the body is shown once.

post.description: US-1.2. Issues a new batch of 10 recovery codes (shown once); every earlier code is spent. 409 mfa_not_enrolled without a confirmed authenticator. Not allowed in a pre-MFA session. Audited as recovery_codes_issue. Requires the CSRF token. Password mode only (404 otherwise); 503 dependency_unavailable when MFA keys are not configured. Needs a step-up within the last 5 minutes (POST /session/step-up), else 401 step_up_required; the guard runs after the permission check, so a caller without the right still gets 403.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store: the body is shown once.

get.description: US-1.3. Password mode, platform_admin grant only (403 forbidden otherwise, platform denied audit). User directory, newest first (created_at, id), keyset-paged. Never returns password hashes, lockout counters or credential versions.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of username, display name or email. LIKE wildcards are literal.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: true = active only, false = deactivated only, all (default) = both.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque `nextCursor` of the previous page. A cursor from other filters is 400.

post.description: US-1.3. Password mode, platform_admin grant only (403 forbidden otherwise, platform denied audit). Creates a local user with a one-time temporary password (CSPRNG, 24 characters) and must_change_password=true. Username is unique case-insensitively; email optional and unique. Requires the CSRF token. Audited as user_create without secrets. Needs a step-up within the last 5 minutes (POST /session/step-up), else 401 step_up_required; the guard runs after the permission check, so a caller without the right still gets 403.

temporaryPassword.description: Shown once; never stored in clear

patch.description: US-1.7. Password mode, platform_admin only. Currently only {"active": false}: sets deactivated_at, revokes every session of the user (admin_revoke), keeps history; anything else is 422. 409 user_inactive when already inactive, 409 last_admin when it would deactivate the last active platform_admin. Requires the CSRF token. Audited as user_deactivate. Needs a step-up within the last 5 minutes (POST /session/step-up), else 401 step_up_required; the guard runs after the permission check, so a caller without the right still gets 403.

Requires the CSRF token. Audited as password_reset_issue without secrets. Needs a step-up within the last 5 minutes (POST /session/step-up), else 401 step_up_required; the guard runs after the permission check, so a caller without the right still gets 403.

post.summary: Local password login for one deployment

401.description: unauthenticated (generic for every password failure), or mfa_required with challengeId after a correct password when the user has MFA: no session yet, continue with POST /api/v1/login/mfa. Users who must use MFA but have not enrolled get 201 with a pre-MFA session (mfaRequired true, mfaEnrolled false). Only with ITSM_MFA=on; with it off (default) every correct password gets a full session.

post.summary: Second login step (TOTP or recovery code)
post.description: US-1.2. Password mode only. Exactly one of code (6 digits, RFC 6238 SHA1/30 s, +-1 step) or recoveryCode. The challenge is single-use and expires after 5 minutes (410 mfa_challenge_expired). A code at or below the last accepted step is a replay and is refused. 5 wrong codes lock TOTP for 15 minutes; a recovery code still works while locked and clears the lock. Every refusal is the generic 401 mfa_invalid. Audited as mfa_verify / recovery_code_used / lockout without codes.

recoveryCode.description: Case, spaces and dashes are ignored.

401.description: mfa_invalid (wrong, replayed, locked, unknown or used challenge) or unauthenticated (missing login header)

post.description: CP4b (A-9). Re-authenticates the current session with a TOTP code or a recovery code; on success the session may use step-up actions for 5 minutes. A recovery code is spent and clears a TOTP lock. Wrong codes count toward the same lockout as the MFA login step (5 failures, 15 minutes); audited as step_up / recovery_code_used / lockout. Not allowed in a pre-MFA session. Requires the CSRF token. Password mode only (404 otherwise); 503 dependency_unavailable when MFA keys are not configured.

401.description: unauthenticated, or mfa_invalid (wrong, replayed or locked code)

post.description: CP4b. Password mode, platform_admin only. Deletes the user's authenticator and recovery codes and revokes every session (mfa_reset); the user must enrol again at the next login when MFA is mandatory. 409 self_mfa_reset for the caller's own account (use DELETE /me/mfa). Needs a step-up within the last 5 minutes (POST /session/step-up), else 401 step_up_required; the guard runs after the permission check, so a caller without the right still gets 403. Idempotent. Requires the CSRF token. Audited as mfa_reset with actor and reason.

CP4b/CP4c. Password mode, platform_admin only. Clears the password and TOTP lockout (failed attempts and locked_until). Needs a step-up within the last 5 minutes (POST /session/step-up), else 401 step_up_required (04-fsd, S-12); the guard runs after the permission check, so a caller without the right still gets 403. Idempotent. Requires the CSRF token. Audited as user_unlock with actor.

put.description: CP5d. Password mode, platform_admin only (any company: the platform admin exemption from the one-company rule). Sets the user's one company, role and administration grants (grants replace the current set of that membership). Other active memberships of the user are deactivated and their grants revoked. Allowed on the caller itself; platform_admin is never changed here. Audited: workspace audit membership.deactivate (reason company_set) per deactivated membership, membership.company_set in the target company, and auth event user_company_set. No change = 200 with changed false and no audit. 409 user_inactive; 422 role, grants or workspaceId (unknown or inactive company). Requires the CSRF token and a step-up within the last 5 minutes when MFA is on (401 step_up_required after the permission check).
